summary: We built a Roblox game where kids launch rockets further by balancing fuel and weight—turning passive screen time into fun, hands-on physics and space learning.
details: The game is a single-player, Lua-based simulation game built on Roblox, designed to inspire and educate both children and aspiring young astronauts. Moving beyond simple entertainment, the project channels early curiosity into hands-on scientific discovery. The core objective of the game is to launch a space rocket further into uncharted destinations with every attempt, turning each flight into an engaging problem-solving experience.
